claim_results.evidence: Pinned code exposes all six purification stages, including Qwen/AudioTag alignment and Apollo super-resolution.
claim_results.target_claim: The Hive construction pipeline mines high-purity single-event segments, aligns them semantically and acoustically, and standardizes audio via super-resolution (Figure 1)

claim_results.evidence: Pinned dataset/model cards declare 2,442 hours and 19.6M mixtures, and Hub metadata exposes large metadata/audio repositories. This run did not download or sum the full audio archive; the naive ontology leaf count is 295 vs claimed 283.
claim_results.target_claim: Hive comprises 2,442 hours of raw audio and 19.6 million synthesized mixtures spanning a 283-class ontology (Section 4.2)

claim_results.evidence: The README describes logic-based co-occurrence constraints, but the pinned source audit did not find a machine-readable compatibility matrix artifact.
claim_results.target_claim: A semantic compatibility matrix is used to avoid implausible event co-occurrences during mixture synthesis (Figure 5)

claim_results.evidence: No released Table 3 result file comparing semantic-consistency constraints against random mixtures was found.
claim_results.target_claim: Enforcing semantic-consistency constraints yields consistent gains over random mixtures built from the same purified single-event sources (Table 3)

claim_results.evidence: Hive-trained AudioSep and FlowSep checkpoint repositories and inference wrappers are present; benchmark Tables 4 and 5 were not recomputed.
claim_results.target_claim: Hive-trained AudioSep and FlowSep are compared against original checkpoints and SAM-Audio on the Hive test set and third-party out-of-distribution benchmarks (Tables 4 and 5)

claim_results.evidence: No released paired co-occurrence/decorrelation result artifact for Table 6 was found.
claim_results.target_claim: Paired co-occurrence/decorrelation tests show Hive training reduces shortcut reliance while controlling target identity, source count, and SNR (Table 6)

title: A Semantically Consistent Dataset for Data-Efficient Query-Based Universal Sound Separation
